A qualifying app may use ordinary libraries and hosted services, but cannot depend on a programmer supplying application-specific implementation or repairs.

criteria.support_condition: Establish a general impossibility that applies to future vibe-coding systems. Failures or the absence of a qualifying example by a finite evaluation date cannot support an unlimited negative forecast.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented qualifying app exists during the forecast period, with verified non-coder authorship, useful functionality, and independent security validation.
